column3: “Swore an oath” renders the first lifting of the hand.
“Resolved” renders said; “vent” renders bringing anger to completion.
“Swore” is supplied to the uplifted hand.
The collective heart is rendered as plural hearts.
“Children” renders sons, “resolved” said, and “vent” bringing anger to completion.
“Swore” is supplied to the uplifted hand.
“Gave them over to statutes” replaces giving statutes to them.
“Pronounced ... unclean” renders making unclean; sacrifice in fire specifies making every opener of the womb pass through.
“Swore” renders lifting the hand; incense specifies the soothing fragrance.
